question: How many users are there in each age category (20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, and others)?
sql:
WITH user_ages AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) 
      - CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) * 31 + EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE)) < (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TRY_CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) * 31 + EXTRACT(DAY FROM TRY_CAST(birth_date AS DATE))) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as age
  FROM mst_users
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN age >= 20 AND age < 30 THEN '20s'
    WHEN age >= 30 AND age < 40 THEN '30s'
    WHEN age >= 40 AND age < 50 THEN '40s'
    WHEN age >= 50 AND age < 60 THEN '50s'
    ELSE 'others'
  END as age_category,
  COUNT(*) as user_count
FROM user_ages
GROUP BY 
  CASE 
    WHEN age >= 20 AND age < 30 THEN '20s'
    WHEN age >= 30 AND age < 40 THEN '30s'
    WHEN age >= 40 AND age < 50 THEN '40s'
    WHEN age >= 50 AND age < 60 THEN '50s'
    ELSE 'others'
  END
ORDER BY age_category
